name: Solvent Yellow 33
description: Solvent Yellow 33 (CAS 8003-22-3 ), also marketed as Quinoline Yellow and approved as D&C Yellow No. 10, is a synthetic quinoline-based colorant used to impart bright yellow hues. Its solubility profile makes it suitable for both solvent-based systems and certain regulated formulations across industrial and consumer product applications where high visibility is required. In personal care and cosmetics, D&C Yellow No. 10 is an approved colorant for use in hair care products, soaps, and topical formulations where a stable, vibrant yellow is required for the brand. Textile and leather processors use this colorant to dye synthetic fibers and finish leather goods, where consistent batch-to-batch color performance is critical for industrial quality control. In paper manufacturing, it is applied to achieve uniform yellow toning in specialty and decorative paper grades. Food-contact and packaging applications may also reference this specific colorant. Regulatory compliance with approved colorant lists is a procurement requirement for many manufacturers. Solvent Yellow 33 is typically supplied as a fine powder or granular solid for easy handling. It is available in cosmetic-grade specifications aligned with D&C approval standards, as well as technical-grade material for industrial textile and paper use depending on the final application. Buyers should confirm grade and purity documentation against the relevant regional regulatory framework prior to sourcing.
